commands:
set -eu
echo NETWORKPOLICIES
k3s kubectl get networkpolicy -n phantom-eval -o wide
echo KUBE_ROUTER_CHAINS
iptables-save 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'KUBE-ROUTER|KUBE-NWPLCY' | head -25 || true
echo ALLOWED_EVAL_TO_PEER
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom-eval deployment/recommendationservice -- python3 -c "import urllib.request; print('status='+str(urllib.request.urlopen('http://emailservice:8080/',timeout=5).status))"
echo CONTROL_PHANTOM_TO_API
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-api-gateway -- python3 -c "import urllib.request; print('status='+str(urllib.request.urlopen('http://phantom-api-gateway.phantom.svc.cluster.local:8080/healthz',timeout=5).status))"
echo DENIED_EVAL_TO_UNAUTHORIZED_INTERNAL_API
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom-eval deployment/recommendationservice -- python3 -c "import socket,sys; host='phantom-api-gateway.phantom.svc.cluster.local'; addr=socket.gethostbyname(host); print('resolved='+addr);
try: socket.create_connection((addr,8080),timeout=3); print('UNEXPECTED_ALLOWED'); sys.exit(3)
except socket.timeout: print('DENIED_TIMEOUT'); sys.exit(0)
except OSError as e: print('DENIED_OSERROR='+type(e).__name__+':'+str(e)); sys.exit(0)"
